name: Clapping Push-Up
instructions: Begin in a standard push-up position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower your body down as in a regular push-up.
At the bottom, explosively push up with maximum force.
Push hard enough to lift your hands completely off the ground.
While airborne, quickly clap your hands together.
Immediately return your hands to the starting position before landing.
Land with your hands in the proper push-up position and bend your elbows slightly to absorb the impact.
This plyometric variation builds explosive upper body power.
